info.title: Satvey Inspect API
info.description: Session-cookie authentication. Every mutating request requires X-Satvey-Request: 1; browser Origin must match APP_URL or an explicitly trusted origin. Organisation routes enforce membership and role permissions. Versioned edits return 409 on conflicts. Image analysis creates draft observations, never approvals.

scoreLevels.description: Empty for legacy binary rules; otherwise exactly six unique scores with a criterion-specific outcome mapping. This is a configurable scale, not a NEN certification.
